newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela sets 80 bln bolivar TEM bill auction.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela sets 80 bln bolivar TEM bill auction.

text.p: The Central Bank of Venezuela announced for Tuesday morning an 80-billion-bolivar auction of 179-, 268- and 358-day "monetary stabilization," or TEM, bills at nominal interest rates of up to 15.55 percent.
The bank said it would offer 40 billion bolivars worth of 179-day bills at a rate of 14.99 percent and 20 billion bolivars of 268-day bills at 15.27 percent.

At its auction last week, the Central Bank, of 80 billion bolivars offered, sold 18.19 billion worth of 179-, 268- and 358-day bills with yields of 15.00 percent, 18.13 percent and 19.84 percent respectively.
